description: Side-by-side sunshine/climate comparison of 2–5 destinations — overall or for one month ("Algarve or Crete in October?"). Returns each place's Sunshine Score, temperatures, rain, midday UV index and sea temperature, plus a one-line verdict of which is sunnier.

month.description: Optional month to compare in; omit for year-round comparison

name: compare_destinations
title: Compare destinations
